method.webfetch: Extracted https://talent.alibaba.com/; HTTP 200, final URL https://talent.alibaba.com/?lang=en, title Alibaba Group Careers. Server-rendered HTML is an application shell with no listing content.
method.cloud_browser: Opened the client-rendered official campus ATS explicitly linked from the company portal. Followed the daily-internship “去投递” card to batchId=100000560002; traversed the pagination UI page by page and captured each visible job card.

classification.main: 207 positions whose official category is 技术类; one 大模型数据工程实习生 whose title directly specifies large-model data engineering.
classification.review: 15 AI-related product internships and one 大模型美学数据 internship. Their list cards identify an AI/product or model-data relationship but omit responsibilities, so technical depth or whether the work is operations/content annotation remains unconfirmed.
classification.excluded: 21 listings whose cards list only cities outside the target set, plus 115 target-city listings whose category/title does not indicate AI, computer or broad computer work.

exceptions: List card details provide title, update date, official job category, cities, business group and stable job ID. Responsibility and requirement text were not present in the captured list cards; the schema fields are null and original card text is preserved in raw_payload.
published_at is null because the card shows an update date, not an original publication date.
